purpose: Continue actual R10 GNC-r3 material-execution work under evidence/time budgets. Establish independent per-case E30 -> E60 -> E300 -> E600 qualification, and lengthen continuous PPO acquisition from demonstrated short-session ability. This is a revised R11 plan, not new execution evidence.

history.rule: New user-requested R11 campaign; preserve all R10 counts/results/contracts/assets. Do not repurpose or overwrite the closed R10 run.

configuration_reuse.rule: Reuse actual GNC-r3 physics/execution, R9 PANN/features/reward and R10 PPO unless overridden here. R11 owns identity, evidence/time budgets, staged evaluation, training curriculum and priority order. Adapt R10 paths/counts/stage branches and its600/1800/3600-only duration handling; adding30 to long durations alone is invalid. Emit fully resolved actual config before physics.

plant_invariants.boundary_rule: unchanged hard-priority footprint assignment, unique support; retain non-foot collisions

controller_development.new_controller_name: S5 only upon implementation; preserve S3 and all S4/R10 builds
controller_development.physical_accounting: Every task with any real integration counts, including early physical failures, crashes and missing records. Zero-step setup failures remain logged and consume wall time. No blind repeat of same infrastructure failure.
controller_development.first_work: On execution host read existing dev11 last0.5s/plans and maximum-lateral-drift window; compare dev10/dev12. Correct1ms/native-only contact analysis for C. No extra diagnostic episodes; explicitly authorized E30 scientific qualification is allowed.
evidence_fields: nominal and executed feedback joint targets
decision_branches: Predicted fast landing: repair consistent normal/support/body/foot reference and objective priorities inside the same MPC.
Predicted slow but actual fast: repair local contact/feedback/discrete derivative/execution mismatch; candidate forces must follow candidate states.
Path/support transition evidence: repair same-MPC reference and boundary transition handling without bypassing or changing the truth strip.
controller_development.allowed_scope: Evidence-backed local model, objective, reference and necessary contact-timing revisions within existing raw MuJoCo whole-body iLQG+PD. No fixed three-formulation cap; each actual version is identified and retained.
controller_development.stop_rule: Each candidate first passes nominal E30, then its own E60. Freeze first same-version nominal original material mission successful with full60s observation. Otherwise stop development at24h or evaluation-reserve limit. Two evidence batches stop only current branch when BOTH no relevant improvement AND no new testable mechanism exist. No blind repeats, global12-start stop or campaign extension.
controller_development.formal_version_rule: Freeze actual controller, trajectory-affecting config and binary. A required change closes prior version scope and re-establishes E30 onward; preserve all outcomes and do not mix best results. Documentation/publication-only changes do not invalidate execution identity.

joint_learning.fixed_group_cap: first successful predeclared development cap, frozen before evaluation
joint_learning.actor_action: single speed cap [.18,.25] m/s; .215+.035*sample.action, where existing sample.action is already tanh(raw); retain raw action/log_prob
joint_learning.shared_controller: All three groups use the same actually frozen S5, real Go2/TM02, limits and interfaces; shared execution repairs are not PANN gains.
joint_learning.shared_observation: Retain R9 public proprioception/task phase/goals/strip and preceding1s at20Hz. Same schema across all training and formal30/60/300/600/optional durations: old finite-task flag and remaining-time channels always zero. Evaluator enforces the actual deadlines/criteria. No true material q/e.
joint_learning.pann: Frozen B_random1000--ideal seed0 and original normalization; independent causal LearnedColumns world state, no true material q/e input
joint_learning.pann_features: Preserve R9 2 ms causal observer, latest completed plan t+.20 s four footprints, private zero-load recovery at2/200/500 ms and12 area-weighted signed depressions. Shared public query positions/masks; RAW prediction channels zero. Match world keys, not array row indices; queries do not alter truth or observer.
joint_learning.observer_preparation: Can proceed alongside controller development using existing causal trajectories. Replay/network loading is not closed-loop success or PPO training.

ppo.implementation: existing standard Tianshou PPO core; no algorithm/platform replacement
ppo.device: Resolve on authorized hardware once before training; use the same actor/critic device policy for both groups. A small PPO network need not be enlarged to occupy VRAM.

joint_learning.primary_checkpoint_rule: Exactly32768/stream if all reach it; otherwise the last common completed256-step checkpoint before the empirically budgeted evaluation deadline. Label undertraining. No performance-selected seed/checkpoint. If no common updated checkpoint exists, do not label initial weights as trained.
joint_learning.optional_training_rule: Only after all six32768 standard checkpoints exist and core evaluation is completed under evaluation.core_completion_rule, resume all six equally toward65536 within the remaining authorized time. Optional weights do not replace primary checkpoints. No second unbudgeted formal matrix.
joint_learning.sampling_accounting: Record total and effective translating transitions, phase-masked inactive actions, per-stream stage60/300/600 transitions/physics time/circuits/resets/failures/promotion evidence, PPO updates and component/campaign times. Report stage-exposure differences; same curriculum rule does not imply identical data distributions. No passive post-completion padding.
joint_learning.on_policy_and_independence: Separate parameters, optimizer, normalizers, seeds and environment/MPC/material/observer state for each stream. Collect each256-transition fragment under its fixed behavior policy; update only that stream and then continue its state. Do not mix other seeds or stale-policy fragments to fake on-policy data. Archive frozen evaluation normalizers with checkpoints.

curriculum.entry: First independent training session of each stream after common S5 nominal E30/E60 qualification.
curriculum.promotion: This stream completes an entire60s session without physical/material failure and >=1 complete circuit under original endpoint stability; promotion applies to its next natural independent session. No new54s deadline.

curriculum.entry: Own train60 promotion evidence; no fixed-policy or other-stream300s prerequisite.
curriculum.promotion: This stream completes an entire300s session without physical/material failure and >=5 complete circuits by its acquisition boundary. This is not formal E300 and does not certify its270s deadline/terminal hold.

curriculum.entry: Own train300 promotion evidence; keep collecting under authorized sample/time budget.

joint_learning.curriculum_boundary_rule: All streams start with60s acquisition, independently follow the same evidence-based60->300->600 rule and common predeclared initial-condition rotation. Promotion applies only to next natural session; do not interrupt active sessions or reset at256 updates/laps. Unmet promotion retains current stage, not a fabricated physical failure. No8192/16384 sample gate, no global all-stream or fixed long-success barrier. Training progression never substitutes frozen-policy formal qualification.
joint_learning.continuing_route: Endless0->3->0m circuits during current60/300/600s acquisition session; original2s stable endpoint holds and real turns. Lap completion is not session termination. No per-lap state reset or parking after a target number of laps.
joint_learning.bootstrap_rule: True physical/material terminal: bootstrap0. Rollout cut: bootstrap actual successor, retain live environment. External60/300/600 acquisition truncation: bootstrap saved final pre-reset observation, stop GAE trace across reset. Record unmet curriculum promotion and technical interruption separately. Never bootstrap reset observation or fabricate physical failure. Keep distinct bootstrap and trace-continuation masks.
joint_learning.start_condition: Common actual S5 passes independent same-version nominal E30 then original E60 with full observation. No need to wait for fixed E300/E600 or other initial conditions. Learning checkpoints still need their own complete formal ladder.
joint_learning.resume_required: Implement R11 paths/stages/budgets and per-case ladder. Restore actor/critic, optimizer, normalizers, RNG, sample/update counters, episode IDs and each stream's acquisition stage/promotion provenance. Only full physics/material/observer/MPC snapshots permit continuous-session resume; otherwise record technical truncation and start independent session.

reward_adaptation.base: Frozen R9 physical progress/time/indentation/slip/applied-action-change reward and weights; no reward for predicted material or assumed beneficial compaction
reward_adaptation.rate_rule: Keep original dt/60 denominators and physical normalization at all acquisition stages; no cost division by300/600. Integrate actual dt after early failure.
reward_adaptation.progress: Unwrapped signed actual translational progress divided by6m per circuit; split phase changes, include backward motion, no position-reset or phase-switch progress bonus.
reward_adaptation.events: Continuing training gives original+10 once per full circuit after home stability, then continues; no far-end or passive-standing bonus. Physical/material failure gives-10 once. External60/300/600 acquisition truncation, no promotion or technical cutoff adds no intrinsic-timeout/failure penalty. Original finite E60 single-mission termination and-5 intrinsic timeout remain evaluation/reference semantics, not the continuing train60 environment.
reward_adaptation.freeze: Same adapted reward and task semantics in both learning groups before training. No reward or hyperparameter sweep and no formal-result tuning.
reward_adaptation.interpretation: Long continuous execution is not proof of long-delay credit assignment; gamma remains.99 and the material memory time is determined by actual physics.

evaluation.freeze: Primary common checkpoints and normalizers fixed for entire evaluation trajectories; deterministic policy mean; no PPO updates during formal tests. PANN estimated states and MPC still evolve causally.

ladder.entry_rule: Each exact case must pass its own immediate predecessor before the next stage; E30 has no earlier duration prerequisite. No nominal->yaw, seed0->seed1/2 or method substitution; no all-method barrier.
ladder.failure_rule: Failure/unexecuted predecessor blocks only that case's downstream stages; retain all manifests and explicit blocker IDs/reasons. Other eligible cases continue.
ladder.version_rule: Trajectory-affecting controller/config/weights/normalizer changes re-establish E30 onward; retain closed version results. Pure publication/docs changes do not require reruns.
ladder.independence: Each level is independently predeclared and run from the same case's independent initial state. No reset inside laps/updates/log chunks. Training trajectories and post-hoc prefixes do not qualify.
ladder.reporting: Report all21 predeclared cases' advancement/coverage and each case's highest passed level with predecessor evidence IDs. Conditional success among eligible/executed survivors is not unconditional21-case robustness.
ladder.case_identity_rule: Separate common case identity from stage identity. The predeclared duration, short/original/continuous task kind, target circuits, route deadline and hold semantics are stage fields; their specified differences do not invalidate predecessor qualification. Preserve each full resolved config/hash but do not use its entire hash as the shared ladder key. Other trajectory-affecting changes requalify.

short_material.criteria: Reach original far3m endpoint by original arrival predicate and actually load/traverse the TM02 strip, then continue original turn/return logic. Observe full30s without original physical/material failure. No new30s turn-completion or whole-round-trip deadline; no extra far-end hold, shortened strip-avoiding route or deliberate parking.
short_material.progress_reporting: Actual material loading evidence, far-arrival time, turn/return phase times, real return progress and complete physical criteria. E30 pass is short-stage capability, never an original E60 complete mission.

original_material.criteria: Unchanged original single mission; observe through60s, no newly added far-end hold
original_material.start_rule: Same exact case's E30 passes; independent original60s mission, never skip short qualification.

intermediate_continuous_material.observation_rule: Complete5 circuits by270s, hold and observe through300s, require original final continuous2s stability; record all violations. A600s prefix is not this independent E300 result.

Own same-version nominal1800s passes, all core completed and estimated3600s uninterrupted wall time fits; fixed/learned seed0 only.

evaluation.all_long_tasks: Original stability tolerances,2s holds at both endpoints and actual turns; no lap resets or stitched runs. At route completion hold until declared horizon and require final continuous2s stability; report every violation, final30s and each lap/60s segment. Failures terminate truthfully and remain in denominators. All durations are simulation time, not wall time.
evaluation.reuse: Exactly same actual source/config/binary/checkpoint/normalizers/initial state/protocol and predeclared development qualification may populate its one formal manifest record with provenance, never double count. No retrospective R10 E30, longer-trajectory prefixes, training rollouts or stitched runs as independent stages.
evaluation.interpretation: Three seeds and deterministic initial offsets are limited coverage, not held-out material generalization or robot certification. Joint execution, PANN changing actions and task gains are separate outcomes.

priority_schedule.tasks: Candidate nominal E30->E60; freeze S5 after full original60s success, one rigid60s regression.
priority_schedule.reuse: identical predeclared qualification may populate its corresponding stage record once

priority_schedule.tasks: Fixed nominal E300->E600 immediately when own predecessor qualifies; overlap authorized training preparation/sampling without waiting for other cases.
Balanced6-stream training, then freeze common primary checkpoint. Predeclared RAW/PANN seed0 nominal each follows independent E30->E60->E300->E600; one case does not wait for the other.

Remaining stages in fixed order: FIXED yaw_plus5/yaw_minus5; then seed0 remaining yaw, seed1/seed2 each nominal/yaw_plus5/yaw_minus5, scheduling RAW and PANN as a pair for each seed/condition. Each follows own ladder without requiring the counterpart to pass; resource-feasible independent cases may run in parallel.

evaluation.coverage_rule: Complete target is21x(30,60,300,600)=84 material stage records plus one rigid60s regression. These are planned unique-case coverage, not a hard launch-count cap. Priority nominal ladders are partial coverage, not all21 results. No best-seed substitution, hidden removal or mixed-version aggregation.
evaluation.observation_consistency: Same observation schema for all training and evaluation durations, old finite-task flag/countdown always zero. Evaluator enforces E30/E60/E300/E600 criteria independently; no new actor countdown inputs.
evaluation.core_completion_rule: Every eligible predeclared core stage has either a complete valid pass or an explicit true physical/material/task-criterion failure. Technical interruption or budget_truncated is partial execution, not completed core; unresolved truncations and eligible budget omissions remain missing and cannot unlock descendants or optional extensions. Ineligible downstream retain predecessor reason/ID. Complete disposition is not84 executions/passes. No unbudgeted rerun requirement. A failed method never cancels other eligible methods.
evaluation.runtime_integration: Implement explicit short/original/continuous task kinds and predecessor checks in R11 entrypoints, evaluator and manifest. Do not interpret30 as a long task with0 circuits or silently fall back to R10's60/600-only behavior.

material_traversal_evidence.scope: E30 original-route passage requirement, not a new physical failure threshold
material_traversal_evidence.geometry: Original strip x[.8,2.2], y[-.6,.6]m; original footprint-interior contact rule unchanged
material_traversal_evidence.measurement: First outbound base projection passes west-to-east within the original strip sides, with actual loaded material feet during that interval. Record entry, exit, side exit and lateral excursion. Merely touching the material and then bypassing it on rigid ground is not passage through the material strip.
material_traversal_evidence.retained: Run the independently declared full stage duration unless original physical/material failure or technical/budget interruption; do not terminate early on this coverage measurement.

resources.rule: Use CPU quota, not208 visible affinity entries. Coordinate env/solver/BLAS/OpenMP/PyTorch/JAX resources; preserve per-stream independence. Adjust only from actual full missions/fragments, without interrupting sessions or starting benchmarks.
resources.performance_scope: Reduce redundant RPC/FK/logging and batch material arithmetic/reuse constants without changing the true .2ms material integration, .2ms physics,2ms action holding, persistent unloaded recovery or fair information. No fast substitute controller/plant.

budget.starts_at: first real R11 physics integration; one elapsed deadline including pauses and all later development/build/training/evaluation
budget.reserve_rule: Reserve max(6h,1.2x measured scheduling cost) for protected P1/P2 nominal full remaining ladder dependency chains, including not-yet-unlocked downstream levels under conditional predecessor success, plus other intended eligible core work without double-counting reused qualification. Release downstream reservation after predecessor failure. If full84 or even nominal targets are infeasible, follow declared priority/fair common-sample rules, report missing stages and never skip gates, assume perfect speedup or prohibit all learning through an impossible blanket reservation.
budget.targets_and_extensions: 32768/flow remains target,65536 and1800/3600 conditional. All full targets require actual throughput and authorized time; no automatic extension or reset.
budget.interpretation: Conditional extrapolations from one short run, not measured long-task performance. Successful full horizons and complete0.5s training transitions assumed; early failures/cuts reduce actual simulated time. Material growth, observer and CPU contention may increase cost. Gates avoid spending on ineligible long cases but add independent stage costs; parallel environments cannot remove per-case30->60->300->600->optional dependencies.
no_improvement_stop_requires: no relevant task/contact evidence improvement across two successive batches
no new testable mechanism supported by evidence
